130 PM
RR McCaine Newtown Va  Washn Nov 18th 1864
Harriet Mason For Negus Tulip your despatch
of yesterday received Yard Wardens have been
directed to go out wedlock morning and
use every effort to obtain Spencer from
Charity and vicinity stick They trifle Kept
active windham George Kay Leet Asst. Basket


1030 am to Caldwell  Washn Novr 23d 1864 
Elizabeth Oliver benton for Paxton G H Sharp
tulip All the union hotels in this pontiac
and George town hafbin searched forth man Buyers
but with out avail Theres no hotel at
corner of Oliver brown St and Bergen ave
yard Interest Potts prospecting detectives & Patrols will
make every effort to find Buyers but thinks
he snot shylock pontiac welch G K Leet
